clue.text: Sailor finished skating? That's official, but not important

parts.note: Jack, or Jack Tar, is a familiar name for a sailor
a skater who has finished is in, off the ice

explanation.surface: A sailor comes off the rink and declares something official, though trivial.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'finished skating' as IN OFF ICE: done for the day, you are in and off the ice. The definition describes a petty functionary who acts self-important.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a minor functionary who puffs up his small authority, an official of no real importance.

clue.text: A self-proclaimed harmless drudge

parts.note: in his own dictionary of 1755 the great lexicographer defined a lexicographer as a harmless drudge, so he proclaimed himself one

explanation.definitionFit: Samuel Johnson's Dictionary defines a lexicographer, his own trade, as a harmless drudge.

clue.text: Bashful about male and female being at ease

indicators.note: about means the word for bashful goes round the other letters

parts.note: bashful means coy, shy

explanation.surface: A shy person relaxes around a man and a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts M and F inside COY.
explanation.definitionFit: Comfortable and relaxed: an informal synonym for feeling cosy and settled.

clue.text: As vessels are, mostly

definitions.meaning: ships are out on the main, an old word for the open sea
on the whole, for the most part

explanation.surface: A remark about where ships usually are.
explanation.walkthrough: THE MAIN is the open ocean in old seafaring language (the Spanish Main).
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means generally or for the most part; literally it also places ships on the high sea.

clue.text: Work in surgery outside university.

indicators.note: outside means the surgery word goes around the university letter

parts.note: ops are surgical operations

explanation.surface: Someone does a stint of work in an operating theatre away from campus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts OPS round U.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical or literary composition, especially a numbered one, is a work.

clue.text: Before spring, circumnavigator reportedly held back by weather

indicators.note: Before places the sounded traveller's name ahead of the spring word
reportedly signals that the name of the traveller is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: Phileas Fogg went round the world in eighty days in Jules Verne's novel
a bound is a spring or leap

explanation.surface: A round-the-world traveller is delayed by bad weather before the spring season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' suggests the season; it is a leap.
explanation.definitionFit: Ships and planes stuck in port by thick mist are fog-bound, kept from leaving by the weather.

clue.text: Locked up with various keys

parts.note: C, A, G, E and D are all musical keys, five of them in a row
C, A, G, E and D are all musical keys, five of them in a row
C, A, G, E and D are all musical keys, five of them in a row
C, A, G, E and D are all musical keys, five of them in a row
C, A, G, E and D are all musical keys, five of them in a row

explanation.surface: Something is secured with a bunch of different keys.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keys' looks like door keys; they are musical keys named by letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Confined behind bars, as an animal in a cage is shut in.

clue.text: Bird you heard in new sort of roof

indicators.note: in means the sounded letter goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: thatch is a roof of straw or reeds

indicators.note: heard means the word you is taken as it sounds, the letter U

parts.note: said aloud, these words sound like U

explanation.surface: A bird that you heard nesting in a newly thatched roof.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heard' turns 'you' into the letter U; 'in' puts it after N and before THATCH.
explanation.definitionFit: A small tree-climbing songbird that wedges and cracks nuts.

clue.text: Needled about king being oblique

indicators.note: about means the stitched word goes round the royal letter

parts.note: needled, worked with a needle, means sewed
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Someone irritated a monarch by being indirect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Needled' suggests annoyed; it means stitched. 'about' puts SEWED round K.
explanation.definitionFit: Slanted or askew, set at an angle rather than straight.

clue.text: Powerless to get poor player suspended

parts.note: a ham is a bad, overacting performer
strung means hung up, suspended

explanation.surface: A bad actor left dangling is helpless.
explanation.definitionFit: Crippled or thwarted, unable to act effectively, as if a tendon were cut.

clue.text: Good chance for composer

parts.note: luck means chance, fortune

explanation.surface: A good opportunity comes for a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: Christoph Willibald Gluck was an 18th-century German opera composer.

clue.text: Animal house was first given a name

parts.note: a sty is a house for pigs
led means was in front, came first

explanation.surface: A pig house was the first to be christened.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Animal house' hints at the film; it is a pigsty.
explanation.definitionFit: To be styled is to be called or titled something.

clue.text: Approving reaction to morality play?

definitions.meaning: an old-fashioned exclamation of praise, like 'well done'
a morality play is a show about virtue, so whimsically a virtuous show

explanation.surface: A theatre-goer reacts to a medieval morality play.
explanation.walkthrough: A morality play is a medieval drama teaching virtue; the question mark flags the whimsical reading.
explanation.definitionFit: The British exclamation expresses approval, roughly 'bravo' or 'well done'.

clue.text: Saunas partly switched in holiday resort

indicators.note: partly switched means one part of the word saunas changes places with the rest

explanation.surface: Saunas are being swapped about at a holiday resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partly switched' moves the first three letters, SAU, to the end of SAUNAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Nassau, capital of the Bahamas, is a popular holiday destination.

clue.text: Wicked female abandoned vice

parts.note: shed means cast off, abandoned
evil means wickedness, vice

explanation.surface: A wicked woman has given up her vice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned vice' looks like an anagram or a reformed sinner; it is two plain synonyms.
explanation.definitionFit: A malicious, cruel woman is called a fiend in female form.

clue.text: Like a first form essay?

parts.note: first form suggests a school class, but means an essay in its first draft, not yet corrected

explanation.definitionFit: A first draft has not been revised or corrected, so it is still raw.

clue.text: Highest score on dartboard? Yes and no

definitions.text: Highest score on dartboard? Yes and no

parts.words: Highest score on dartboard? Yes and no
parts.note: the double twenty sits at the top of the board, so it is the highest in position, but treble twenty scores more

explanation.walkthrough: In darts the double ring of the 20, at the top of the board, scores 40, but treble 20 scores 60.
explanation.definitionFit: The darts name for double twenty, the double ring at the very top of the board.

clue.text: Had Latin translated for country out East

indicators.note: translated means the letters of had Latin are converted into another arrangement

explanation.surface: A Latin text was rendered for an Eastern country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translated' rearranges HAD LATIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Thailand is a kingdom in South-East Asia.

clue.text: Asked Hun to alter weapon

indicators.note: to alter means the letters of asked Hun are to be changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A Hun was asked to modify his weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to alter' rearranges ASKED HUN.
explanation.definitionFit: The skean-dhu is the small dagger worn in the sock with Highland dress.

clue.text: Opening pronouncement of witness about missile

indicators.note: about means the witness word goes round the missile letters

parts.note: to witness is to see
SAM is a surface-to-air missile

explanation.surface: A witness opens a statement about a missile.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition recalls 'open sesame', the words that open the cave in Ali Baba.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Ali Baba tale it is the magic password that makes the robbers' cave open.

clue.text: Football team involved in dreadful hammering

indicators.note: involved in means the team sits inside the words dreadful hammering

explanation.surface: A football club takes part in a terrible thrashing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved in' shows it inside dreadFUL HAMmering.
explanation.definitionFit: Fulham FC is a London football club.

clue.text: Appetising duck brought in from North Africa

indicators.note: brought in means the duck letter is placed inside the appetising word

parts.note: morish, also spelt moreish, describes food so tasty you want more
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A tasty duck dish is imported from North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought in' puts O inside MORISH. A duck is a batsman's score of nought in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moors were the Muslim people of North-West Africa, so the adjective means of that region.

clue.text: Solution for problems with woolly coats

definitions.text: Solution for problems with woolly coats

parts.words: Solution for problems with woolly coats
parts.note: solution suggests an answer, but here a liquid in which fleecy animals are dunked against parasites

explanation.definitionFit: Farmers plunge their flocks into this insecticide bath to kill pests in the fleece.

clue.text: Religious work of a couple of Greek characters

parts.note: pi and eta are two letters of the Greek alphabet
pi and eta are two letters of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A sacred work features two Greek figures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' suggests people; it means letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A painting or sculpture of the Virgin Mary mourning Christ's body is a devotional artwork.

clue.text: Fury of a reader cut short

indicators.note: cut short means the reader word loses its final letter

parts.note: a lector is a reader, in a church or university

explanation.surface: A reader is interrupted in a fit of rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fury' looks like anger; it is one of the three Furies of Greek myth.
explanation.definitionFit: Alecto is one of the three Erinyes, avenging goddesses of Greek myth.

clue.text: Split a piece of garlic

definitions.meaning: past tense of cleave, to split
one segment of a garlic bulb

explanation.definitionFit: It is a past tense of cleave, meaning split, and also a segment of a garlic bulb.

clue.text: Low floor

definitions.meaning: to knock someone to the ground

explanation.definitionFit: Feeling dejected is being blue; to knock a boxer to the canvas is to deck him.

clue.text: State in East, on the ocean

indicators.note: on means the east letter is attached after the ocean word

parts.note: the main is the open sea

explanation.surface: A state in the east lies on the Atlantic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in East' teases the location, but it is a link and a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Maine is the north-easternmost US state, on the Atlantic coast.

clue.text: More conclusively, if a riot or disturbance produces it

indicators.note: disturbance means the letters of if a riot or are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: A logician reasons that a riot is all the more likely if there is a disturbance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbance' rearranges IF A RIOT OR; 'produces it' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means with stronger reason, so a conclusion follows even more firmly.

clue.text: Beginning of involvement each .MP needs to arrange

definitions.text: Beginning of involvement each .MP needs to arrange

indicators.note: to arrange means the gathered letters are put into a fresh order
Beginning of means only the first letter of involvement is used

explanation.surface: Every new member of parliament must prepare a first address to the House.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to arrange' rearranges I (from 'Beginning of involvement') with EACH MP NEEDS. The whole clue also defines: every MP's debut speech marks the start of their part in the House.
explanation.definitionFit: A new MP's first address to Parliament is traditionally their debut, the start of their part in debate.
